questions.stem: Many services call one shared `RetryExecutor`, and a bug is found in it. Per this page, what follows from sharing it?

options.text: It is one point of failure for its callers, and also one point of fix
options.says: The page calls a shared utility a single point of failure, but also a single point of fix.

options.text: It is one point of failure for the callers written after the bug
options.says: The page says the shared utility is a single point of failure: every caller uses the same code.

options.text: It is one point of fix after each service copies it into its code
options.says: The page's point is that callers share one RetryExecutor instead of pasting their own loops.
